name: myapi
description: Official MyApi plugin for Cursor and Grok Bot. Connect agents to the MyApi AI agents hub (services, memory, AFP machines, automations).

MYAPI_ENROLL_CODE.title: MyApi enroll code
MYAPI_ENROLL_CODE.description: Single-use dashboard Quick Connect code. Expires in about 15 minutes. Mint one at https://www.myapiai.com, then paste it in Plugins Configure — never in chat.

MYAPI_TOKEN.title: MyApi token (optional)
MYAPI_TOKEN.description: Optional fallback. Used once to register the MCP Ed25519 keypair (or as a Bearer token if MYAPI_AUTH_MODE=token). Prefer Quick Connect. Never paste long-lived tokens in chat.
